description.value: Champions Guild Automation: Additional Spells: Entangle, Misty Step, Conjure Animals, Dimension Door and Conjure Elemental are always prepared once you have slots of that level (add them from the compendium). Persistent Conjuration: while you concentrate on a Conjuration spell, the module adds your spellcasting ability modifier to the Constitution saves to keep it.

system.requirements: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature

automation.notes: Champions Guild Automation: Persistent Conjuration bonus on Concentration saves by the module.
